links.outcome: GPT-4o translation quality (MQM score) by language versus human translators
links.effect: Noninferior for Portuguese and Arabic; worse for Haitian Creole (mean MQM 90.5 ± 5.5 vs 97.0 ± 2.1); linguists preferred human translation in 69% (SE 7%) of Haitian Creole cases.
links.quote: Noninferiority testing showed no significant difference in translation quality between GPT-4o and human translations for Portuguese and Arabic, but worse performance by GPT-4o than human translations for Haitian Creole (mean MQM score 90.5 ± SD 5.5 vs 97.0 ± SD 2.1).

unlisted_practices: Human post-editing/validation of LLM medical translations, with more intensive post-editing for lower-performing languages

screen.reason: Evaluates the translation accuracy and quality of GPT-4o on pediatric discharge instructions evaluated by professional medical translators across multiple languages compared to human translation, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
